newsitem.title: USA: US Defense Stockpile sells 69.82 mln lbs rubber.
newsitem.headline: US Defense Stockpile sells 69.82 mln lbs rubber.

text.p: The US National Defense Stockpile announced today it has sold 69,820,171 pounds of natural rubber for about $33.8 million.
The rubber consists of ribbed smoked sheets, grades 1, 2 and 3 and technically specified rubber grades 5 and 20, the agency said.
Contract awards were made to two companies: Fenley Trading Inc and Lewis & Peat Rubber.
The contractors have one year to remove the rubber from the storage locations.
Additional rubber will be offered from the Stockpile in the future, the agency said.
Fenley Trading Inc of Norfolk, Virginia, was awarded 30,758,180 pounds based at Topeka, Kansas for $14.3 million and 296,053 pounds at Scotia, New York for $150,000.
Lewis & Peat Rubber of Middlebury, Connecticut, was awarded 38,800,000 pounds stored at Scotia, New York for $19.35 million.
